gen-dafont-junegull-gf-anek-gujarati: Junegull has a lowercase as tall as cast iron capitals. Anek Gujarati, a sans-serif, keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals and gapes wide at the c, so paragraphs flow along easily.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Anek Gurmukhi is a sans with big open counters, quite unlike the closed shapes of Junegull. And its open-handed curves would carry a long text forward without clogging up, line after line.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-anek-kannada: Retro and friendly, Junegull has pinched curves and a tall lowercase. Anek Kannada has a high, squared-off x-height and terminals that stop far from the stem, so a full page of text moves briskly.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-anek-latin: Retro charm, then a reset: Junegull is at its best skimming along in one stroke weight. And Anek Latin is at its best staying open, its tall lowercase nearly reaching the capitals.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-anek-malayalam: This body text reads with lowercase that sits almost at cap height, and curve tips that never quite meet. Anek Malayalam lets the single-line, toothpaste-squeezed strokes of Junegull stay the loud voice on the page.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-anek-odia: Junegull has no hairlines anywhere in its alphabet, a retro and friendly face. But Anek Odia, a sans-serif with rounds unsealed like an unlatched hook, makes the pair work: closed against open.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-anek-tamil: Junegull does its best work with strokes that never swell or thin, w included, all retro and friendly. Anek Tamil, a modern sans, does best with big round lowercase bowls and curves that look half unwrapped.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu reads with wide, tall bowls setting the rhythm, and its rounds stay unsealed like an unlatched hook. Beneath Junegull, a full page of text keeps rolling along.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-anuphan: Anuphan reads through big round bowls and open curves with clear gaps. Junegull, with its retro, uniform strokes and curves that never thin at the shoulders, supplies the display punch up top.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-arimo: Junegull looks like retro letters cut from strips of equal width. Arimo, with its tall mean line and spacious terminal gaps, opens up what the heading keeps closed, so the two hold a page between them.
